review.images: Visually checked all seven images from the official Mangrove page, including a distinct plaza hero, three exterior views and three interior scenes. The street frontage is the card. The lobby is identified separately from the living room and bedroom.
review.location: Compared the official pin and area map with the Creek Beach masterplan in the project brochure. Verified the five-minute Creek Marina caption on physical page 7. The separate 700-metre caption describes the beach length.
review.floorPlans: Reviewed all 43 physical PDF pages including both covers and the area panels of all 41 sheets. The official Building 1 PDF provides 17 sheets. An Emaar-branded original hosted by Petkovic Properties provides 24 Building 2 sheets. All square-foot component sums agree. Building 1 page 5 omits part of the metric unit abbreviation on the balcony line, so the original sheet is preserved and the selector uses square feet.

unavailable: Signed unit-specific area, building entrance details, current transport service and travel times to other destinations require confirmation.
